name: My Leads Report
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Lead ID:Link/Lead:150",
    lead_name AS "Lead Name::200",
    status AS "Status::120",
    source AS "Source::120",
    email_id AS "Email::180",
    phone AS "Phone::120",
    mobile_no AS "Mobile::120",
    creation AS "Created On:Datetime:180",
    owner AS "Created By:Link/User:150"
FROM
    `tabLead`
WHERE
    owner = %(user)s
ORDER BY
    creation DESC
